text:
maya: Heads up — prod auth started returning intermittent 502s at ~03:12 UTC. Initial heap/leak theory ruled out; looks like a token cache regen loop introduced by auth-lib 1.3.8.

alex: Noted. Error-rate spike on /v1/stream measured ~03:15. Traffic degradation about 6% for some routes.

ops-oncall: I applied a short-term route rule to shift non-critical traffic to fallback pool eu-west1.

maya: Proposal: emergency pin auth-lib -> 1.3.7 and do a rolling restart of auth pods. Low-risk, no schema changes, no migrations.

jon: Quick question — will sessions break? Any user-facing invalidation?

maya: No DB changes. Sessions may drop for ~0.1% websocket connections during pod restarts; otherwise graceful.

sasha: We usually canaries for 30m but this is P1. Requesting expedited approval to skip full canary and do a 10m change window. Need release lead + eng-sre ack. @alex @jon please confirm rollback plan.

alex: Rollback plan laid out: if error rate or latency increases by >5% we revert to 1.3.8 and pause traffic routing. We also have a staged fallback to the dedicated capacity pool.

deploy-bot: [deploy request] user=maya service=auth action=patch image=ghcr.io/redwood/auth:1.3.7-candidate sha=sha256:abc123 start_window=now change_window=10m

maya: Command I'll run:
```
kubectl set image deployment/auth auth=ghcr.io/redwood/auth:1.3.7 --record
kubectl rollout status deployment/auth -w
```
Make sure to annotate the release with: "emergency: pin auth-lib -> 1.3.7 to mitigate token regen loop"

jon: +1 from eng-sre. I'll be watching logs, traces, and infra alerts. On pager for next 60m.

alex: +1 release lead. Approving expedited skip of 30m canary for a 10m change window. Ensure postmortem and release note.

ops-oncall: Deploy started at 03:28 UTC. Rolling pods one at a time.

deploy-bot: Rollout update: 3/3 pods updated, health checks passing. Progress: 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete at 03:32 UTC. Health checks OK. Observability: error-rate back to baseline, latency stable.

maya: Thanks all. Filing release note and follow-up: open PR for 1.3.9 fix + test coverage for token regen. I'll pin the catalog entry back to 1.3.7 until 1.3.9 is validated.

sasha: Retro action: add a synthetic integration test for token regen and shorten critical dep vetting checklist.

alex: Great work — please link the postmortem when ready and mark the Dedicated pools unaffected.

maya: Will do. Closing thread.
